title: 110825 - Coast Guard conducts search and rescue flights to warn mariners of Hurricane Irene
description: PORTSMOUTH, Va. - The Coast Guard dispatched an HC-130 Hercules aircrew to fly along the coast of Virginia and North Carolina warning mariners of Hurricane Irene, Aug. 25, 2011.  The flight lasted approximately three hours using VHF-FM channel 16. U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 3rd Class David Marin.
